Tesla flying Roadster launch night took over the whole watchlist: rawsalerts Waco airspace/Polymarket (~517k), 'flying cars before GTA VI' (~348k, 25k likes), 'WHAT THE' (~307k), Tesla +61% since Walz '225 & dropping' (~192k, 11.8k likes), drives upside down (~186k), DeSantis legal in Florida/The Villages (~170k); alx unveil clips (~276k, ~201k); Gunther 'flying cars before Newsom's train' (~163k, 25.8k likes)

Bend, Oregon elementary school shooting: rawsalerts first alert (~307k); Gunther's police statement that a community member stopped the shooter (~169k, 9.8k likes), Kotek thanking the hero (~185k), police withholding gun details (~106k), 'good guys with guns' one-liners (~43k each)

Ilhan Omar raid aftermath: Trump 'go back to her own country' (~49k), husband snaps on whether she left the country (~44k), revoke-her-passport (~41k), 'Flying Teslas. Ilhan Omar getting raided' victory-lap (~57k, 6.8k likes)

Texas & midterms: Talarico vs Christian mom (~69k), Paxton 'fought for our border, guns and kids' (~47k, 6.2k likes), Hinojosa debate stunt (~55k), CNN admits GOP could expand Senate (~51k), Michigan flip-it-red (~36k)

Government overreach receipts: Jack Smith collected Trump supporters' financial info (~54k, 6k likes), DOJ sues California over 20k suspected noncitizens (~41k), abolish property taxes (~55k), judge tosses NYC sanctuary suit (~36k)
Team & gratitude posts convert: 'Trump runs the show, Vance fights, Rubio makes the world respect us' (~94k, 17.4k likes), 'he took a bullet for it' (~44k), Elon 'glad he's on my team' (~38k)

Format notes: live-event pile-ons (a dozen short Roadster posts in two hours) stacked six figures each; one-line jokes contrasting private builders with government failure (Newsom train, GTA VI, Walz stock call) earned the highest like rates; tragedy coverage that centered the hero outperformed raw casualty updates
virals_narrative: Outsider AI sweep (~48h, 25 posts) was quiet again: nothing cleared 5k views. Tops were a '365 days of AI' daily recap (~4k), Jensen Huang urging US-China AI safety dialogue (~1.8k), devs recreating Photoshop features with AI (~680), and a 'stop calling chatbots AI' take (~530). The rest was regulatory chatter (FTC subpoenas and EU AI Office probes of OpenAI and Anthropic), Meta's Muse Wonder launch, and AWS/Anthropic hiring races. Watchlist heat, led by the Tesla Roadster night, carried the board.
